title: Jacob program
author: Mads I.
desc: The Jacob Program is a comprehensive 12-week training plan designed for beginners looking to build strength and muscle using bodyweight exercises and minimal equipment in a garage gym setting. With 36 sessions scheduled over the course, each workout lasts about 40 minutes, focusing on essential movements like the Romanian Deadlift, Overhead Press, and various pull-up variations. This program emphasizes progressive overload and double progression techniques, ensuring you continually challenge your muscles for optimal growth. Get ready to transform your fitness journey with structured workouts that fit seamlessly into your schedule!
